comments.author: 999Jupiter999
comments.body:
I do see a lot of comments saying that your bill is taking too long, everybody has their own type of workflow and I think you ironing out the most important stuff first instead of letting the AI assume what you want and do it fast, is actually a refreshing way of seeing it. 

As much as the AI does tend to get things right on the first or second try and be able to do it really fast I still think longer workflows have their place.

Keep working on it, everybody will hate it until it's finished and they love it.
